verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on linking commits or merge requests to issues, and nothing on issue status changing automatically from commit messages. The nearest items are the GitHub importer preserving cross-references during migration and agents turning issues into merge requests. Neither is the story's capability. The axis clearly applies to a DevSecOps platform with issue tracking, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link commits and pull requests to issues and have issue status update automatically from commit messages
